protocol: 1 epoch on the same random 8,000 training reviews (seed 42), frozen word embeddings, batch 32, max length 128; scored on the full validation split (3,867 reviews). Test split not used.
tie_break: DistilBERT multilingual (cased) scored 0.0067 higher on validation macro-F1, a small gap for a single 1-epoch run on 8,000 reviews. Multilingual MiniLM-L12-H384 was chosen because it is smaller and faster, which matters for CPU serving inside a 250 MB serverless function.
